svg.title: The lifted algebra and the specified continuous product algebra
svg.desc: Exact symbolic comparison for the cyclic three-point action with masses one, two and four, and an infinite ineffective stabilizer. The lifted discrete orbit keeps u=p_x lambda fixed and has three points. Its algebra has the L-infinity center of u. The defined continuous product representation has an independent continuous orbit coordinate zeta and a separate unchanged base lambda multiplicity. Its algebra contains all bounded operators on the orbit-coordinate Hilbert space and has scalar center. A normalized rank-one operator mixes two orbit intervals. The owner theorem is Imported Theorem 4.2; the computations are Exercises 6.7 and 6.8.
svg.text: Two algebras, two different continuous coordinates
Γ = C₃ × ℤ acts on X = {0, 1, 2}; masses p₀ = 1, p₁ = 2, p₂ = 4.
The ℤ stabilizer is ineffective. Every discrete orbit has three distinct points.
u = px λ is fixed along each orbit
Orbit coordinate: ζ ∈ Λ, measure dζ/ζ
Base coordinate: λ ∈ Λ, measure dλ
Represented with the base identity factors.
An exact interval-mixing operator on the orbit coordinate
k(ζ, η) = a(ζ) b(η)* acts as |a⟩⟨b|
Qf(ζ) = ζ−1/2f(ζ) changes Haar to Lebesgue measure on the orbit factor.
Q Lk Q* has kernel 1[1,2](ζ) 1[2,3](η); the base λ-factor is unchanged.
Exact symbolic tensor diagram. Different centers prevent identifying these two algebras.
Book-notation correspondence remains the owner's stated AF08 boundary; no source-page artwork is used.
